ember.when: the character is stuck, avoiding, putting off, tired, ashamed or failing
ember.draw: the small flame on the tip of the main character's tail has shrunk to a dim glowing ember with a thin wisp of grey smoke

bright.when: the character starts or is working on something
bright.draw: the flame on the tip of the main character's tail burns big and bright orange

golden.when: the character has just done the step or finished — the moment of reward and relief
golden.draw: the flame on the tip of the main character's tail burns tall and golden with small bright sparks flying off it
